item.question: How can performance metrics typically defined at an aggregate level be evaluated within a multilevel framework?
item.answer: Performance metrics like true standard error or standard error calibration, usually defined at an aggregate level, can still be effectively evaluated within a three-level MLMM framework. This approach allows for added benefits and approximations that enhance inference and interpretability.
